payload.headline: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, broad market (SPY) sideways, fear normal as of Nov 13 (latest reading not stored yet).

verdict.text: 2 setups triggered today; none is eligible to act on. QQQ fell 2.7% and stays below its 50-day average: the downtrend continues. Fear was normal on Nov 13 (VIX 19.3); the latest reading isn't stored yet. No setup is approved: 6 live setups are blocked, most often by "QQQ is not above its 50-day average". Nothing has a proven edge, so the default is no action. Next decision points: NVDA earnings Nov 17; GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits, 3rd Quarter 2026 Nov 25 08:30; Personal Income and Outlays, October 2026 (includes PCE inflation) Nov 25 08:30.

Nvidia's Colette Kress confronts key questions in first earnings report since Jensen Huang’s exit (CNBC Technology; confirmed). Touches NVDA (Hold). Reported results test the growth and margin assumptions behind the valuation.

NVIDIA Expands Vera CPU Platform to Accelerate Scientific Discovery (NVIDIA Newsroom; confirmed). Touches NVDA (Hold). Capital spending drives supplier demand but consumes the spender's free cash flow. Potential spillover: TSM (positive), AMD (mixed), MU (positive), INTC (mixed).

Tesla is inviting some people to buy a Cybercab ‘for personal use’ — but read the fine print (The Verge; confirmed). Touches TSLA (Reduce). M&A changes the business mix, balance sheet and competitive landscape.

Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders ‘for personal use,’ with geo restrictions and a $299 monthly fee (TechCrunch; confirmed). Touches TSLA (Reduce). Chip demand signals feed directly into semiconductor revenue estimates. Potential spillover: GOOGL (mixed), NVDA (negative).

Heating oil prices are up 59% from last winter. The spike is 'crushing folks,' Maine nonprofit says (CNBC Top News; confirmed). Market-wide. Rates move the discount rate on long-duration growth equities and the cost of financing AI capex.
SPY fell 1.9% to 739.95.
QQQ fell 2.7% to 661.75.
